description: This file contains helper functions for initializing and retrieving a GORM database handle within a storage package, specifically handling different database dialectors and context-scoped database access.

methods.name: initGormDB
methods.description: Initializes the shared GORM database handle based on the configured mode (Postgres or SQLite) using the existing SQL connection.

methods.name: gormWithContext
methods.description: Returns the GORM database handle scoped to the provided context, initializing it if necessary.
